# Acme Corp IT and HR Policy Handbook

Document ID: ACME-POL-2026-014 | Version: 4.0 | Owner: People & Technology Office | Last
Reviewed: 2026-09-01
This handbook applies to all full-time employees, contractors, and interns of Acme Corp across all
regional offices. Where local law is stricter than this policy, local law prevails.

## 1. Remote Work Policy

### 1.1 Eligibility and Philosophy

Acme Corp believes that great work can happen anywhere, provided that the conditions for focus,
collaboration, and security are met, and this belief has shaped our hybrid model since 2021 when
the company first moved away from a mandatory five-day office presence; employees whose roles
do not require physical access to labs, warehouses, or customer sites are eligible to work remotely
for up to three days per week after completing their 90-day probation period, although managers
retain the discretion to request in-office attendance for onboarding sessions, quarterly planning
events, client workshops, and any situation where in-person collaboration is judged to be materially
better for the outcome, and employees who wish to work remotely for more than three days per

## 3. Leave and Time Off

### 3.1 Annual Leave

Full-time employees accrue 1.75 days of paid annual leave per month, totaling 21 days per
calendar year. Up to 5 unused days may be carried forward into the first quarter of the following
year; any remaining days expire on March 31.

### 3.2 Sick Leave

Employees are entitled to 10 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required for
absences longer than 3 consecutive working days.

### 3.3 Requesting Leave

1. Submit the request in the HR portal at least 10 working days in advance for planned leave.
2. Your manager approves or declines within 3 working days.

### 4.2 Acceptable Use of Company Systems

Company laptops, accounts, networks, and software licenses are provided primarily for business
purposes, and while Acme Corp permits limited, reasonable personal use such as checking
personal email during a lunch break, reading the news, or making a short personal video call, this
privilege must never interfere with work responsibilities, consume significant bandwidth or storage,
expose the company to legal or reputational risk, or involve activities such as cryptocurrency
mining, torrenting copyrighted material, operating a personal business, accessing gambling or adult
content, or installing browser extensions and desktop applications that have not been approved by
IT; employees should also understand that all activity on company-managed devices and networks

### 4.3 Prohibited Activities

The following are strictly prohibited and may result in disciplinary action up to and including
termination:
- Sharing your credentials with anyone, including colleagues and IT staff.

metadata.section_path: Acme Corp IT and HR Policy Handbook > 4. Information Security and Acceptable Use > 4.3 Prohibited Activities

metadata.document_title: Acme Corp IT and HR Policy Handbook

- IT will never ask for your password by email, chat, or phone.
- Disabling or bypassing endpoint protection, disk encryption, or the VPN.
- Forwarding L3 or L4 data to personal email accounts or messaging apps.
- Uploading customer data or source code into unapproved AI tools or public code-sharing sites.
- Approved AI tools are listed on the IT wiki page Approved AI Tools Register.
- If a tool is not on the register, submit a request using the form described in Section 5.2.
- Connecting unknown USB storage devices to company equipment.
- Using company resources to harass, threaten, or discriminate against anyone.

### 4.4 Reporting a Security Incident

If you suspect a phishing email, malware infection, data leak, or unauthorized access, report it
immediately. Speed matters more than certainty; we would rather investigate ten false alarms than
miss one real incident.

## 5. Software and SaaS Procurement

### 5.1 Approved Software

The IT team maintains a catalogue of pre-approved software that any employee can install through
the self-service portal without additional approval. This includes office productivity suites, approved
browsers, password managers, communication tools, and common developer tools such as Git,
Docker Desktop, and VS Code.

### 5.2 Requesting New Software

To request software that is not in the catalogue, follow these steps:
1. Search the catalogue first to confirm no approved alternative exists.
2. Submit a Software Request ticket that includes:

metadata.section_path: This line is part of a quote, not a heading.
metadata.h1: This line is part of a quote, not a heading.
metadata.document_title: Acme Corp IT and HR Policy Handbook

text:
1. The business purpose and the expected number of users.
2. The vendor name and a link to its security or trust page.
3. The classification level of the data the tool will process.
3. Information Security completes a vendor risk review within 10 working days.
4. If the tool will process L3 or L4 data, Legal reviews the vendor's data processing agreement.
5. Procurement negotiates the contract and IT provisions licenses through single sign-on (SSO).
Free trials and "freemium" tools are not exempt from this process if they will process any company
data.

### 5.3 Software License Costs

Annual license costs are charged to the requesting department's budget.

## 7. Code of Conduct

### 7.1 Respectful Workplace

Acme Corp is committed to a workplace free from harassment, discrimination, and retaliation. This
commitment applies in offices, at client sites, at company events, during business travel, and in all
digital channels including Slack, email, and video calls. Behaviour that would be inappropriate in a
meeting room is equally inappropriate in a direct message.

### 7.2 Conflicts of Interest

[[PAGE 6]]
Employees must disclose any situation in which their personal interests could conflict, or appear to
conflict, with the interests of Acme Corp. Common examples include:

- Hiring or directly managing a close family member or partner.
- Accepting a second job or board position with a company in a related industry.
- Accepting gifts or hospitality worth more than USD 100 from a current or prospective business

Disclosures are made through the Conflict of Interest form in the HR portal and are reviewed

### 7.3 Speaking Up

Employees who witness or suspect a breach of this handbook, the law, or our values are
encouraged to raise it with their manager, HR, or Legal. Reports can also be made anonymously
through the independent Ethics Hotline, which is available 24/7 in 12 languages.

courses, certifications, conference tickets, and books related to their current role or a realistic future
role at Acme Corp.

### 9.2 Leaving Acme Corp

Employees who resign must give the notice period stated in their contract. On or before the last
working day, the departing employee and their manager must ensure that all company equipment is
returned, all access is revoked, and knowledge is handed over.

Important: Access to all systems is disabled automatically at 18:00 local time on the employee's
last working day.

## 10. Glossary

MFA – Multi-factor authentication; logging in with a password plus a second factor such as an
authenticator app.
MDM – Mobile device management; software that lets IT secure and update company devices
remotely.
